name: radar-chart
title: Radar Chart
description: Multi-dimensional polygonal telemetry web with concentric rings, radial spokes, specular stroke highlights, and interactive vertex inspection nodes.

props.name: data
props.description: Array of axis metrics with label, value, and optional fullMark

props.name: size
props.description: Square dimensions of chart viewport in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Base color tint for polygon boundary and fill gradient

props.name: fillOpacity
props.description: Opacity of translucent interior web polygon

props.name: showGrid
props.description: Renders concentric polygonal web rings and spokes

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Renders axis labels around the outer perimeter

examples.title: Agent Capability Profile
examples.description: Multi-axis capability web with interactive vertex inspection.
examples.code:
<RadarChart
  data={[
    { axis: 'Latency', value: 88 },
    { axis: 'Throughput', value: 92 },
    { axis: 'Reliability', value: 99 },
    { axis: 'Coherence', value: 85 },
    { axis: 'Precision', value: 94 },
    { axis: 'Memory', value: 76 },
  ]}
  size={280}
/>
